title: 2026 Captain Contest Consistency
label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED
purpose: Preserve historical observations for future human/AI research review. Research metadata has no production consumer.
success_definition: rank <= floor(full contest field*0.10); competition-rank boundary ties all count. Fractional credit allocates only remaining top-decile slots across the boundary tie.
limitations: 10 games and 30 imported contests are a partial convenience sample; four other primetime games are missing. Entries and account-game rosters are dependent, boundary ties affect top-decile counts, and the watchlist was screened on the same sample. This is descriptive, not a causal effect, future edge or production rule. No payout/ROI claim is supported.

findings.title: WR/TE Captain paired with own QB
findings.observation: Successful WR/TE Captain lineups paired with their own QB in 88.9% of watchlist successes versus 81.1% of reference-field successes.
findings.comparison_baseline: 104 of 117 successful watchlist WR/TE account-game rosters versus 26,289 of 32,418 successful reference-field WR/TE account-game rosters. Success means a top-decile contest finish; roster copies within account/game are deduplicated. Watchlist: 19 robustness-screened accounts.
findings.limitations: The watchlist was selected retrospectively; small receiver subset, repeated players/games and varying field composition prevent a pairing requirement or causal inference.
findings.label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED

findings.title: QB construction varies by game period
findings.observation: One-QB versus two-QB construction performance varies materially by game period. Early: one QB 11.9%, two QBs 7.6%; later: one QB 9.2%, two QBs 12.3%.
findings.comparison_baseline: Tie-adjusted top-decile hit rates in the largest imported contest per game: first six games (2026-09-09 through 2026-09-24) versus later four (2026-10-01 through 2026-10-08). One-QB denominators: 189,712 early / 155,861 later; two-QB: 115,303 / 89,732.
findings.limitations: Only six early and four later game environments; entrants and game conditions differ, and no universal QB-count preference is justified.
findings.label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED

findings.title: Team splits vary by game period
findings.observation: 5–1 versus 3–3/4–2 performance varies; no universal preferred split is justified. Early: 5–1 15.0%, 3–3 8.4%, 4–2 9.2%; later: 5–1 6.8%, 3–3 11.8%, 4–2 10.2%.
findings.comparison_baseline: Same largest-contest-per-game, tie-adjusted early-six versus later-four comparison. 5–1 denominators: 63,443 / 54,974; 3–3: 111,884 / 89,071; 4–2: 158,048 / 129,374.
findings.limitations: Game/entrant composition and small period samples confound the comparison; neither a split quota nor a preferred construction follows from it.
findings.label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED

findings.title: Unused salary does not establish a target
findings.observation: Successful watchlist and reference-field lineups both had approximately $400 median unused salary; no fixed salary-left target is justified.
findings.comparison_baseline: Known-salary successful account-game rosters: 230 watchlist versus 66,590 reference-field rosters; each has $400 median salary left.
findings.limitations: A median is a descriptive center, not an optimal target. Salary coverage is incomplete for eight successful field rosters; no controlled salary experiment or future validation was performed.
findings.label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED

findings.title: Early account performance did not persist collectively
findings.observation: Accounts selected from early strong performance did not outperform the later field collectively: 9.7% versus 10.0%.
findings.comparison_baseline: Later four games: pooled tie-adjusted entry hit rate 9.6778% for the early-selected cohort versus 9.9974% for the later field. Select on first six games only: at least four games, 20 known distinct account-game rosters, 20% tie-adjusted roster hit rate and hits in at least three games. 95 selected accounts; 89 appeared later.
findings.limitations: Short holdout with unequal entry volume and dependent entries. Handles identify platform accounts, not verified people; participation/survivorship and selection bias remain. Account rankings must not become live features.
findings.label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED
